o1: Enables GTPase activating protein binding activity and GTPase activity. Involved in apical protein localization; endocytosis; secretion by cell; endocytic recycling; basolateral recycling; and proper cargo release from early endosomes into the recycling pathway. Is located in cholinergic synapse; cytoplasmic vesicle; periciliary membrane compartment; and early endosome. Is expressed widely, including in intestine. Is part of the endocytic recycling pathway. Interacts with RABX-5. Orthologous to several human genes including RAB5B (RAB5B, member RAS oncogene family) and RAB5C (RAB5C, member RAS oncogene family).
